# Carlito 1.103

Unmodified Calibri-compatible fonts from LibreOffice crosextrafonts-carlito-20130920. SIL OFL 1.1; see LICENSE.txt. Loaded on demand only for missing Calibri faces, after embedded, host, local and provider fonts.

Bundled by [DocViewKit](../../README.md). The project's Apache-2.0 license does not replace Carlito's SIL OFL 1.1; retain [LICENSE.txt](LICENSE.txt), copyright notices and the pinned hashes below when redistributing these four faces. Release validation checks the exact reviewed files and includes their license in each artifact.
